samples.question: The image shows two square plates side by side, each bounded by a printed registration frame. Each plate is ruled into the same 7 by 7 grid of cells, and every cell of both plates is filled edge to edge with fine vertical stripes of the same width and the same spacing; only the position at which a cell's stripes start differs from cell to cell. Pair each cell of the left plate with the cell in the same row and the same column of the right plate, and compare the two stripe patterns of the pair. Mark the cell when the two patterns are out of step, meaning the right plate's dark stripes sit nearer to the middle of the left plate's light gaps than to its dark stripes, so that laying the right plate over the left would close the gaps and fill the cell solid. Leave the cell unmarked when the two patterns are more nearly in step, so that laying one plate over the other would leave the cell striped. The marked cells form a shape that most closely matches one of these five symbols: cross, ring, saltire, tee, wedge. Which symbol is it? Answer with one word.
